messages:
jessica: Quick follow-up from the billing incident postmortem — I want to lock the action items, owners, and timelines so we actually close these before the next invoice cycle.

mike: Agreed. I started a short checklist in the incident doc but let's put owners here for visibility.

arjun: TL;DR root cause was delayed token ingest from the edge pipeline + a ledger merge race that double-counted fallback shards for ~3hrs. Fix mitigations look reasonable but we need a reprocess plan for affected customers.

elaine: Estimated impacted invoices: ~120 customers, mostly on Dedicated, with ~2-15% token overcount on those days. We should offer credits and a corrected invoice batch.

samir: Action item: identify exact customer ledger_ids and affected date ranges. Owner: samir. ETA: 2026-03-25 EOD for initial list.

jessica: samir noted. Add priority flag for enterprise customers first.

samir: Will do. I'll run a targeted query: `SELECT ledger_id, sum(tokens) FROM token_ingest WHERE ingest_time BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12' GROUP BY ledger_id HAVING sum(tokens) > expected_threshold;`

mike: Action item: add a short-term guard in the real-time aggregator to drop duplicate shard merges and emit metrics. Owner: mike + eng-runtime. ETA: 2026-03-23 morning.

arjun: For reprocess, we should: 1) freeze affected ledger rows, 2) recompute token counts from raw events, 3) produce a delta file for billing. Owner: arjun. ETA: first run 2026-03-26.

elaine: Finance action: prepare invoice correction templates and credit ledger entries. Owner: elaine. ETA: 2026-03-27. Need legal signoff for messaging to enterprise accounts.

jessica: Also add a monitoring watchlist so recurring incidents are detected: a weekly job to surface any 5%+ deviation vs baseline. Owner: jessica. ETA: 2026-03-24.

billing-bot: Incident action created: #INC-2026-143, assigned to samir, mike, arjun. Reminder set at 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC.

arjun: We should keep reprocess idempotent. Plan to use `recompute_v2(ledger_id, start_ts, end_ts)` that writes to a separate table `billing_deltas_v2` and flags processed windows. Sample SQL: ```INSERT INTO billing_deltas_v2 (ledger_id, window_start, window_end, delta_tokens) SELECT l.ledger_id, '2026-03-10','2026-03-12', SUM(real_tokens)-SUM(ingested_tokens) FROM raw_events r JOIN ledger_map l ON r.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE r.ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12' GROUP BY l.ledger_id;```

samir: Note: need to account for prometheus-gc windows where KV cache truncated. I'll add that to the reprocess doc.

mike: Ops follow-up: add a canary reprocess on a test subset (10 customers) and validate deltas against expected. Owner: mike. ETA: 2026-03-25.

elaine: Customer comms draft: short apology, explanation of overcount, credit timeline, and an offer to contact support. I'll share draft in #customer-success for review. Owner: elaine. ETA: 2026-03-24 noon.

jessica: Who will own the credits run? We need a list and the script to apply credits safely (idempotent).

arjun: I can produce the delta file; finance needs to apply. Propose a credits-run playbook: 1) ingest `billing_deltas_v2`, 2) generate CSV with ledger_id, amount, reason, 3) preview on staging, 4) apply to prod via the `credits-apply` job with dry-run first.

elaine: I'll own step 2 and 4. Will coordinate dry-run with ops.

samir: For recurring pattern detection: I'm adding a rule to our anomaly detector to flag ingestion latency spikes > 15m that correlate with token deltas. Owner: samir. ETA: 2026-03-30.

mike: Long-term: add a deployment-time check that validates no overlapping shard merges. RFC: eng-runtime 2026-Q2. Owner: mike.

jessica: Let's capture acceptance criteria for each item in the incident tracker. Quick list:
- samir: affected ledger list + reproducible query + confirmation that list covers all impacted.
- mike: aggregator guard deployed, canary done, and grafana panels updated.
- arjun: reprocess run done for 10 customers and delta table verified.
- elaine: customer comms drafted + credit run executed for pilot batch.

jessica: Please update the postmortem page with links to the Reprocess playbook, Credit run playbook, and the RCA note. I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow to review the pilot results.

arjun: One more note: we found a pattern where small periodic ingest delays during heavy burst windows caused cumulative divergence over days — that suggests we should lower the merge window from 10s -> 2s under high-concurrency mode. I'll prototype a config flag. Owner: arjun. ETA: 2026-04-02.

elaine: I'll prepare customer-facing FAQ lines to include in support replies.

mike: tagging @oncall for the canary run: please standby on 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC.

jessica: Thanks all. I'll update the tracker and ping again once samir posts the ledger list. :thumbsup:
